description: This file implements functions and data structures for handling X509_NAME objects in OpenSSL, including encoding, decoding, canonicalization, and memory management of X509_NAME and X509_NAME_ENTRY structures.

classes.name: X509_NAME
classes.description: Structure representing an X509 distinguished name, including entries, cached encoding, and canonical form.

classes.name: X509_NAME_ENTRY
classes.description: Structure representing a single entry in an X509_NAME, including object identifier, value, and set index.

methods.name: x509_name_ex_new
methods.description: Initializes a new X509_NAME structure with empty entries and buffer.

methods.name: x509_name_ex_free
methods.description: Frees memory associated with an X509_NAME structure.

methods.name: x509_name_ex_d2i
methods.description: Decodes an internal ASN1 representation into an X509_NAME structure.

methods.name: x509_name_ex_i2d
methods.description: Encodes an X509_NAME structure into ASN1 format.

methods.name: x509_name_encode
methods.description: Encodes the X509_NAME into a buffer, updating the cached encoding.

methods.name: x509_name_canon
methods.description: Generates a canonical form of the X509_NAME for comparison purposes.

methods.name: asn1_string_canon
methods.description: Converts ASN1 strings to a canonical UTF8 form, normalizing spaces and case.

methods.name: i2d_name_canon
methods.description: Serializes the canonical name structure into a buffer.

methods.name: X509_NAME_set
methods.description: Sets a X509_NAME pointer to a duplicate of another, freeing previous.

methods.name: X509_NAME_ENTRY_set
methods.description: Returns the set index of a X509_NAME_ENTRY.

methods.name: X509_NAME_get0_der
methods.description: Retrieves the DER-encoded form of an X509_NAME.
